summary.heading: Professional Summary
summary.body: Product leader and people manager with 13+ years in enterprise SaaS across real estate, transportation, logistics, and virtual collaboration. Builds and coaches product teams into autonomous domain owners, grounds roadmaps in direct customer evidence, and drives practical AI adoption in daily product work. A player-coach who also designs and ships full-stack mobile and web applications.
experience.heading: Experience
experience.exprealty.title: Principal Product Manager
experience.exprealty.bullet_1: Consolidated legacy systems into My eXp for ~88K agents — profile, mentorship and transaction workflows in one experience — avoiding ~$6M in three-year licensing costs.
experience.exprealty.bullet_2: Grew monthly active users from 26K to 59K (+127%) by expanding My eXp from a revenue-share tool into a business platform for the full agent base across ~20 countries.
experience.exprealty.bullet_3: Developed four business analysts into product managers and restructured ownership around accountable business domains across a ~30-engineer organization.
experience.exprealty.bullet_4: Introduced direct user discovery to an organization that relied on internal stakeholders — personally ran 50+ agent conversations and made customer evidence a routine roadmap input.
experience.exprealty.bullet_5: Turned around an unreliable AI copilot into an insight-driven, permission-aware product, reaching ~95% measured answer accuracy against source data.
experience.exprealty.bullet_6: Trained ~20 PMs and partners in AI-assisted workflows, shifting PM time from story administration to discovery and stakeholder work.
experience.virbela.title: Lead Product Manager
experience.virbela.bullet_1: Helped rebuild Virbela's product organization, managing and coaching three product managers through Senior PM across server, client and web/data domains for ~2.5 years.
experience.virbela.bullet_2: Conducted 200+ customer interviews and introduced structured discovery sprints, reducing wasted engineering effort 25% in the first year.
experience.virbela.bullet_3: Refocused strategy on the strongest customer and market problems for a platform serving 40+ countries, increasing adoption 28% in two years.
experience.virbela.bullet_4: Led GDPR implementation — self-service deletion, PII handling and pseudonymization — opening the European market.
experience.virbela.bullet_5: Launched a reseller channel in Japan and Korea, increasing revenue ~15%, and built the business case for monetizing Virbela's customer-facing APIs.
experience.virbela.bullet_6: Replaced siloed, fastest-team-wins delivery with cross-functional design across server, desktop and web teams, improving release cadence and performance.
experience.virbela.bullet_7: Led a generative AI support chatbot grounded in Virbela knowledge sources, balancing hallucination risk, usefulness and model cost.
